responsibility: This file implements a frontend parse-tree rewrite pass for Fortran coarray expressions before GENERIC lowering, specifically for the library-based coarray mode (`-fcoarray=lib`). It walks `gfc_code` and `gfc_expr` trees after semantic resolution, detects coindexed references and intrinsic coarray operations, rewrites remote reads and writes into generated callback/accessor procedures and `CAF_GET`/`CAF_SEND`/`CAF_SENDGET` style helper calls, adjusts array and derived-type metadata for remotely accessed objects, and registers the synthesized accessors so later translation and runtime communication code can materialize correct remote-image data movement semantics.
